lesson.sea_turtle_pattern_swim.title: Sea Turtle Pattern Swim
lesson.sea_turtle_pattern_swim.summary: Draw a sea turtle swimming upward, build a shell pattern and invent your own playful variations.
lesson.sea_turtle_pattern_swim.step.tilt: Tilt the shell on a diagonal, then stretch the neck and head toward the upper corner.
lesson.sea_turtle_pattern_swim.help.tilt: Let the shell lean instead of sitting flat. The head should continue that swimming direction.
Great tilt. Your turtle already feels like it is moving.
lesson.sea_turtle_pattern_swim.step.swim: Add four flippers at different angles so the turtle feels mid-stroke.
lesson.sea_turtle_pattern_swim.help.swim: Make the nearest front flipper the biggest and let the others point in different swimming directions.
Those flippers make the pose feel active.
lesson.sea_turtle_pattern_swim.step.shel: Build three simple shell pattern shapes, then use them as a starting point for your own pattern idea.
lesson.sea_turtle_pattern_swim.help.shel: Repeat a shape, change its size or turn it. Your pattern does not have to match anyone else's.
Nice pattern rhythm. The shell has its own personality.
lesson.sea_turtle_pattern_swim.step.bubb: Add a few bubbles in the swimming direction, then choose any extra mark you want.
lesson.sea_turtle_pattern_swim.help.bubb: Keep the bubbles away from the shell so they help the composition instead of covering the turtle.
Your turtle is swimming through a playful scene.
Color the turtle and patterns however you like. Try a palette that feels like your ocean world.
